/-! ## DIMCID vs CupodBot: mutual cooperation (C, C)

Both bots are `.search` bots. The proof shows that neither bot's guard can be
proved at any budget, using well-founded induction on the proof size.

Key: any PlaysProof of a plays-atom must come from `search_t`, which embeds
a sub-PlaysProof of a related atom at a strictly smaller budget. This creates
an infinite descending chain, impossible.
-/

/-- From a PlaysProof of `.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D`, extract a sub-PlaysProof
of `.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D` at a strictly smaller cost. -/
theorem extract_symm_cupod {k n : Nat} {h : PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D n} :
    ∃ m, m < n ∧ PlaysProof (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D m := by
  cases h with
  | search_t hguard hbody =>
      -- hguard : Pf m ((.plays .opp .self .D).subst (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k))
      --        = Pf m (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)
      -- hbody : PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (.const .D) .D cost_body
      -- n = cost_body + c_guard k + c_node
      -- hguard.cost < n
      refine ⟨hguard.cost, ?_, hguard⟩
      -- Need: hguard.cost < n
      -- n = cost_body + c_guard k + c_node
      -- c_guard k ≥ 1, c_node = 1
      have hn : n = hbody.cost + c_guard k + c_node := rfl
      have hpos : 1 ≤ c_guard k := by
        simp [c_guard, numCost]
      omega
  | search_f hneg hbody =>
      -- search_f produces PlaysProof for the else-branch (.const .C), not .D
      nomatch h
  | const => nomatch h
  | self => nomatch h
  | opp => nomatch h
  | bot => nomatch h
  | sim => nomatch h
  | ite_t => nomatch h
  | ite_f => nomatch h

/-- From a PlaysProof of `.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D`, extract a sub-PlaysProof
of `.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D` at a strictly smaller cost. -/
theorem extract_symm_dimcid {k n : Nat} {h : PlaysProof (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D n} :
    ∃ m, m < n ∧ PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D m := by
  cases h with
  | search_t hguard hbody =>
      -- hguard : Pf m (guard.subst (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k))
      -- guard = .impl (.plays .self .opp .C) (.plays .opp .self .D)
      -- guard.subst (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = .impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .C) (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D)
      -- hbody : PlaysProof (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) (.const .D) .D cost_body
      -- n = cost_body + c_guard k + c_node
      -- hguard.cost < n
      refine ⟨hguard.cost, ?_, hguard⟩
      have hn : n = hbody.cost + c_guard k + c_node := rfl
      have hpos : 1 ≤ c_guard k := by
        simp [c_guard, numCost]
      omega
  | search_f hneg hbody => nomatch h
  | const => nomatch h
  | self => nomatch h
  | opp => nomatch h
  | bot => nomatch h
  | sim => nomatch h
  | ite_t => nomatch h
  | ite_f => nomatch h

/-- Mutual unprovability via well-founded induction on the proof budget. -/
theorem cupod_atom_not_provable (k : Nat) : ¬ Pf k
    (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D) := by
  -- We prove a stronger statement by induction on the budget:
  -- For all k, Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) → False
  -- AND Pf k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D) → False
  -- simultaneously, using the extraction lemmas above.
  
  -- First, define the two atoms
  let A := .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D
  let B := .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D
  
  -- We prove ∀ k, ¬ Pf k A ∧ ¬ Pf k B by induction on k
  have h_induction : ∀ k, (¬ Pf k A) ∧ (¬ Pf k B) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
        constructor
        · intro hpA
          cases hpA with
          | atom hatom =>
              rcases hatom with ⟨hpp, hle⟩
              -- hpp : PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D n
              obtain ⟨m, hm_lt, hpp'⟩ := extract_symm_cupod hpp
              -- hpp' : PlaysProof (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D m
              -- From hpp' we can get Pf m B (since B = .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)
              have hpfB : Pf m B := Pf.atom ⟨hpp', by omega⟩
              -- m < n ≤ k, so m < k
              have hm_lt_k : m < k := by omega
              -- From ih, we know ¬ Pf m B (since m < k)
              rcases ih m hm_lt_k with ⟨_, hB⟩
              exact hB hpfB
          | _ => nomatch hpA
        · intro hpB
          cases hpB with
          | atom hatom =>
              rcases hatom with ⟨hpp, hle⟩
              obtain ⟨m, hm_lt, hpp'⟩ := extract_symm_dimcid hpp
              have hpfA : Pf m A := Pf.atom ⟨hpp', by omega⟩
              have hm_lt_k : m < k := by omega
              rcases ih m hm_lt_k with ⟨hA, _⟩
              exact hA hpfA
          | _ => nomatch hpB
  
  exact (h_induction k).1

/-- DIMCID's guard is never provable. -/
theorem dimcid_guard_not_provable (k : Nat) : ¬ Pf k
    (.impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.C)
           (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D)) := by
  intro hp
  -- From hp : Pf k (A_impl → B) where A_impl = .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .C, B = .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D
  -- Use searchBranch for DIMCID to derive Pf k B, contradicting cupod_atom_not_provable
  let guard := .impl (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.C)
    (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D)
  
  -- searchBranch for DIMCID:
  -- Pf.searchBranch k guard Action.D Action.C (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) rfl hle
  -- gives: Pf k (.impl (.box k (guard.subst ...)) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D))
  -- guard.subst (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = guard (since .self→DIMCID, .opp→Cupod)
  -- So: Pf k (.impl (.box k guard) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D))
  
  have h_search : Pf k (.impl (.box k guard)
      (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D)) :=
    Pf.searchBranch k guard Action.D Action.C (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) rfl
      (by
        -- Need conclusion size ≤ k
        -- |.impl (.box k guard) (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)|
        -- = |.box k guard| + |.plays ...| + 1
        -- = (log2 k + 1 + |guard|) + (|DIMCID k| + |CupodBot k| + 1) + 1
        -- For large k this is ≤ k. For small k, we need a different argument.
        -- Actually, if k is too small for the conclusion to fit, then hp itself
        -- can't exist because |guard| > k.
        by_cases hk : k < guard.size + 20 * Nat.log2 k + 30
        · -- guard is too large for the budget
          have hpf_size := pf_size_or_atom.mp hp
          rcases hpf_size with (hsz | hatom)
          · omega
          · -- hatom : AtomProvable k guard, but guard is an impl, not a plays-atom
            nomatch hatom
        · simp only [numCost, Formula.size, guard, DIMCID, CupodBot, Prog.size]
          omega)
  
  -- boxIntro on hp
  let sz_box : Nat := (Formula.box k guard).size
  have h_box : Pf (k + sz_box) (.box k guard) :=
    Pf.boxIntro k (k + sz_box) guard hp (Nat.le_refl _)
  
  -- mp combines h_search and h_box
  let sz_impl : Nat := (Formula.impl (.box k guard)
    (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D)).size
  have h_plays : Pf (k + (k + sz_box) + sz_impl)
      (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) :=
    Pf.mp k (k + sz_box) (.box k guard)
      (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) h_search h_box
      (by omega)
  
  -- Now h_plays gives us Pf of .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D
  -- From this, by the same extract_symm_dimcid lemma, we'd get an infinite descent.
  -- But we already have cupod_atom_not_provable which directly contradicts
  -- the symmetric atom .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D.
  -- h_plays is about .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D, not about cupod_atom.
  -- We need to convert.
  
  -- Actually, we need a different extraction: from Pf of .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D,
  -- we can derive Pf of .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D using CupodBot's transparency.
  -- This is the same searchBranch + boxIntro + mp chain but starting from the DIMCID atom.
  
  -- Let's do it:
  let B' := .plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D
  let B := .plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D
  
  -- From h_plays : Pf K B' (where K = k + (k + sz_box) + sz_impl)
  -- Use searchBranch for CupodBot:
  -- CupodBot k = .search k (.plays .opp .self .D) (.const .D) (.const .C)
  -- searchBranch: Pf K (.impl (.box k ((.plays .opp .self .D).subst (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k)))
  --   (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D))
  -- = Pf K (.impl (.box k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)) (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D))
  -- = Pf K (.impl (.box k B') B)
  
  have h_search2 : Pf K (.impl (.box k B') B) :=
    Pf.searchBranch k B' Action.D Action.C (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) rfl
      (by
        -- Need conclusion size ≤ K
        -- |.impl (.box k B') B| = |.box k B'| + |B| + 1
        -- = (log2 k + 1 + |B'|) + |B| + 1
        -- ≤ log2 k + 1 + (2*log2 k + 16) + (2*log2 k + 16) + 1 = 5*log2 k + 34
        -- K = k + (k + sz_box) + sz_impl ≈ 2k + ... which is much larger than 5*log2 k + 34 for large k
        -- For small k, K might be small too, but then hp wouldn't exist.
        by_cases hK : K < 5 * Nat.log2 k + 34
        · -- K is too small. But K ≥ k (since K = k + ...), and if k is large enough,
          -- K should be large enough. Let's check.
          -- Actually K = k + (k + sz_box) + sz_impl = 2k + sz_box + sz_impl
          -- sz_box = |.box k guard| = log2 k + 1 + |guard|
          -- sz_impl = |.impl (.box k guard) B'| = |.box k guard| + |B'| + 1
          -- So K ≥ 2k, which is > 5*log2 k + 34 for k ≥ 10.
          -- For small k, the size condition might fail, meaning hp can't exist.
          -- Let's just use omega with the actual sizes.
          have hK_ge_k : k ≤ K := by omega
          -- If K < 5*log2 k + 34, then k < 5*log2 k + 34
          -- This means k is small (≤ ~20). In that case, we can check directly.
          -- But for the proof, let's just use omega which handles these arithmetic constraints.
          omega
        · omega)
  
  -- boxIntro on h_plays
  have h_box2 : Pf (K + (Formula.box k B').size) (.box k B') :=
    Pf.boxIntro k (K + (Formula.box k B').size) B' h_plays (Nat.le_refl _)
  
  -- mp combines h_search2 and h_box2
  let sz_impl2 : Nat := (Formula.impl (.box k B') B).size
  have h_B : Pf (K + (K + (Formula.box k B').size) + sz_impl2) B :=
    Pf.mp k (K + (Formula.box k B').size) (.box k B') B h_search2 h_box2
      (by omega)
  
  -- Now h_B contradicts cupod_atom_not_provable
  exact cupod_atom_not_provable k h_B

/-! ## Outcome theorem -/

/-- **DIMCID vs CupodBot: mutual cooperation (C, C) for all k ≥ 0.**
    Both bots' guards are unprovable at every budget, so both fall through to
    their cooperate else-branches, yielding (C, C). -/
theorem llm_outcome_DIMCID_vs_CupodBot :
    ∃ k₂, ∀ k, k₂ < k →
      ∃ fuel, outcome fuel (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some (.C, .C) := by
  refine ⟨0, fun k _ => ⟨2, ?_⟩⟩
  have hA : play 2 (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) = some .C := by
    have hg := dimcid_guard_not_provable k
    have hps : proofSearch k
        ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
          (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k)) = false := by
      cases h : proofSearch k
          ((Formula.impl (.plays .self .opp Action.C) (.plays .opp .self Action.D)).subst
            (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k)) with
      | true =>
          have hp := (proofSearch_spec k _).1 h
          simp only [Formula.subst, Prog.subst, DIMCID, CupodBot] at hp
          exact absurd hp hg
      | false => rfl
    unfold play DIMCID
    simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst, hps]
  have hB : play 2 (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) = some .C := by
    have hg := cupod_atom_not_provable k
    have hps : proofSearch k
        (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) = false := by
      cases h : proofSearch k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D) with
      | true =>
          -- proofSearch true → Pf k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)
          -- From this, by extract_symm_dimcid + Pf.atom, we get Pf of the symmetric atom
          -- which contradicts cupod_atom_not_provable
          have hp := (proofSearch_spec k _).1 h
          -- hp : Pf k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)
          -- We need to derive Pf k (.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D) from this
          -- This is exactly what the searchBranch + boxIntro + mp chain does,
          -- which we already proved in dimcid_guard_not_provable.
          -- But we can also use a simpler argument: from hp, by extract_symm_dimcid,
          -- we get a sub-PlaysProof at budget m < k, and then Pf.atom gives Pf m.
          -- Since m < k, this contradicts the induction in cupod_atom_not_provable.
          -- Actually, cupod_atom_not_provable already handles this via its internal induction.
          -- Let's just use the same extraction here.
          -- We need to show: Pf k (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D) → False
          -- This follows from the same induction as cupod_atom_not_provable.
          -- Let's extract it as a separate lemma.
          sorry
      | false => rfl
    unfold play CupodBot
    simp [eval, Prog.subst, Formula.subst, hps]
  exact outcome_of_plays _ _ _ _ _ hA hB

end PD.Theorems

/-! ## DIMCID vs CupodBot: mutual cooperation (C, C)

Both bots are `.search` bots. The proof shows that neither bot's guard can be
proved at any budget, using well-founded induction on the proof size.

Key: any PlaysProof of a plays-atom must come from `search_t`, which embeds
a sub-PlaysProof of a related atom at a strictly smaller budget. This creates
an infinite descending chain, impossible.
-/

/-- From a PlaysProof of `.plays (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) .D`, extract a sub-PlaysProof
of `.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D` at a strictly smaller cost. -/
theorem extract_symm_cupod {k : Nat} {n : Nat}
    (h : PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) Action.D n) :
    ∃ m, m < n ∧ PlaysProof (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) Action.D m := by
  cases h with
  | search_t hguard hbody =>
      -- hguard : Pf m ((.plays .opp .self .D).subst (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k))
      --        = Pf m (.plays (DIMCID k) (CupodBot k) .D)
      -- hbody : PlaysProof (CupodBot k) (DIMCID k) (.const .D) .D body_cost
      -- n = body_cost + c_guard k + c_node
      -- hguard is a Pf, we need its cost
      -- Pf doesn't have a .cost field; we need to get it differently.
      -- Actually, hguard : Pf k (...), and Pf_sound gives us a play witness,
      -- but not the cost. We need a different approach.
      
      -- The key: hguard is a sub-proof of the PlaysProof. Its budget is some m ≤ k.
      -- We can't directly access m from hguard.
      -- But we know that in the search_t constructor, the Pf m argument has budget m
      -- and the total cost n = body_cost + c_guard k + c_node.
      -- Since c_guard k ≥ 1 and c_node = 1, we have n ≥ body_cost + 2.
      -- The sub-PlaysProof (hbody) has cost body_cost < n.
